data.name: Disease Lore
data.description: A forensic physician can use Heal to identify a disease after only 1 minute of examining the symptoms (DC = the disease's saving throw DC), and he can spend 1 minute and attempt a Heal check at the same DC to disinfect an infected object or corpse. He receives a +%1 bonus on saving throws against diseases.|2*(InvestigatorLVL/3)
